mission.name: EarthWatch-1

orbit.name: Low Earth Orbit (LEO)
orbit.note: 500 km is the chosen scenario altitude for this educational mission, not a universal CubeSat orbit.

mission.purpose: Observe selected areas of Earth and collect images that help users understand environmental changes.

spacecraftSize.source: CubeSat Design Specification Rev. 14.1; NASA Small Spacecraft Technology State of the Art 2026, Structures chapter.

targetWetMassKg.note: A conservative design target below the 12 kg 6U limit. This is a project allocation, not the measured mass of a built satellite.

solarArray.status: manufacturer product data listed in NASA 2026 survey; mass is calculated as peak power divided by specific power

battery.status: NASA 2026 survey lists a 6.0 Ah pack and 172 Wh/kg; voltage/energy are derived from a nominal 4S Li-ion configuration and should be confirmed with the exact vendor datasheet.

averageGenerationW.note: Simplified orbit-average value; do not confuse with the solar array's 57.6 W peak rating.

powerBudget.note: The spacecraft must duty-cycle high-power camera and transmitter operations. Peak load may exceed average generation and is supported temporarily by the battery.

gameBudgetCredits.note: Credits are game points, not real procurement prices.

massAllocation.note: Within NASA's published 6U structure mass range of 0.916–1.94 kg.

massAllocation.subsystem: Thermal control, harness, and deployment hardware

componentCatalog.name: 6U body-mounted solar panels
componentCatalog.status: mass_and_cost_are_game_assumptions; peak power is a NASA-listed product example

componentCatalog.name: 6U deployable solar array
componentCatalog.status: peak power and calculated mass based on NASA-listed SP6X data; credits are game assumptions

componentCatalog.name: High-capacity Li-ion battery pack
componentCatalog.status: energy and estimated mass based on NASA-listed GomSpace pack data

objectives: Capture simulated images of selected areas on Earth.
Transmit collected data to a simulated ground station.
Complete the mission while respecting mass, power, storage, and budget limits.
dataQualityRules: NASA-listed product values are reference examples, not universal values for all CubeSats.
All values marked game_design_assumption are fixed game-balancing values, not verified hardware specifications.
Do not present the 500 km scenario altitude as a universal Earth-observation orbit.
Do not claim NASA imagery was captured by the fictional EarthWatch-1 satellite.
